title: Restore research CI navigation after the PR6030 selection
body:
The [PR #6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030) promotion changes the selected record but leaves current CI navigation on [PR #5599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599), and puts the decimal plus fraction inside one bold span where the current-status check expects the exact bold decimal. These two mismatches fail the shared onboarding job and skip scientific replay for new research PRs, including [PR #6047](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6047) and [PR #6049](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6049).

Add the current [PR #6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030) replay, review, validation and source-manifest links; retain the entire [PR #5599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599) section as a historical checkpoint. Format the selected decimal separately from its unchanged fraction. No certificate, selected record, proof source or historical evidence is changed.

Validation: all six existing tests in `test_research_current_status.py` pass on CPython 3.12.8; `git diff --check` passes. The failure is documented in [the hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40625338509). No supplier replay is required for these navigation edits.

## Significance for researchers

Restores the shared entry point for scientific replay after the selected-result update. It changes no mathematical claim or κ.

## Open next questions

Future selected-result promotions should update these navigation sections alongside the selected record; the existing tests already enforce the contract.

Prepared by [zxv](https://github.com/zxv) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Dependent archived jobs now run and expose stale source bindings: `historical-1042-link` and `test-suite-locale-reads` reject `docs/research/current-status.md`; `d8-mixed-target-seeda97c8e` rejects the already-current `autoresearch.md`. The current-status navigation tests pass. No frozen pin is migrated or weakened; disposition of those archived consumers is a separate maintainer task.
